mentions.name: PAX ERP
mentions.description: An AI-assisted ERP system for small regulated and job shop manufacturers, combining ERP, CRM, and GAAP accounting in one product. It requires no formal training or implementation fees and is designed to be intuitive and well-documented so users can pick it up and start using it without support questions.
mentions.problem: Small manufacturers outgrow QuickBooks but traditional ERP implementations are too expensive and time-consuming.
mentions.audience: Small regulated/job shop manufacturers that have outgrown QuickBooks and cannot afford or take the time for a traditional ERP implementation.
mentions.source_excerpt: PAX ERP. An AI-assisted ERP for small regulated/job shop manufacturers that have outgrown QuickBooks and can't afford (or take the time) to go through a traditional ERP implementation.

evidence.value: PAX ERP. An AI-assisted ERP for small regulated/job shop manufacturers that have outgrown QuickBooks and can't afford (or take the time) to go through a traditional ERP implementation.
